events.detail: a ray-cast of the agentview camera over axis-aligned cubes was compared with the saved development images before the calibration thresholds above were written; the first hypothesis (whole cube) gave a 2.8 px bias and a 0.5 area ratio, the second (top face only) matched; the thresholds were then declared in code and committed before this run

the first offline test run failed the metric-depth fit because the far/near ratio was assumed to be 5000; robosuite base.xml sets znear=0.001 and MuJoCo's zfar is 50 (ratio 50000, only the extent is fitted); the CAL_DEPTH_RMS_M tolerance was not changed

after the constants were corrected the extent fit (about 10.6) still had an all-pixel RMS of 6.9 mm and a max error of 77 mm, caused by silhouette-edge pixels; the median error is small. The depth fit was a check the implementation added, not a criterion of the card (Phase D is the projected centroid agreement), so it is reported as informational with robust statistics; no card threshold was changed
the final summary printed the depth-fit RMS key that no longer exists (shown as 'rms None'); the summary text was regenerated from the saved outputs, the analysis was not rerun
